exact_parity.scope: Uniform binary parity law. These exact information statements are not a chosen partial-information-decomposition estimator or a claim of novel synergy mathematics.

level_loss.interpretation: Normalized projection loses constant levels; the full summary still contains the distinction.

four_way_obstruction.scope: Four-way parity is genuinely lost by fixed-role full second moments. Conditioning additionally on a retains the b/outcome relation. No generic automatic refinement rule is established.

storage_scope: Only mean/scatter numeric payload, excluding keys, Python objects, integer counters and snapshots; there are two observed contexts in this campaign.
